knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The source is unknown. Recording and referral come before any repair or intrusive opening.
The guideline advises not to paint, seal or cover surfaces until they are dry.
These are the sources the guideline lists in section 3.3. The other lists name different hazards.

practicalCriteria: For a fictional property, the learner completes the questionnaire and photograph log with dates and reporters, and writes the referral note.
The learner separates observed, reported and assumed items in the written record.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: A cavity is opened to look for the source without an approved plan.
A cleaning or painting decision is made before the source is identified.
